evidence: timbertrailsrvpark.com (read 2026-10-22): 2027 daily full hookup $55 non-holiday, $75 holidays; phone booking only; 17 of 162 sites daily/weekly/monthly on the park map, every lakeshore site seasonal. No Good Sam park stated. Nearest gateway Grand Rapids 99 km; no stays. No --AWH note.

name: Vista Point RV Campground (Jordan Lake SRA)
reason: group RV camping with no single-site reservations (AWH 2026-10-22: drop)
evidence: split-1, read 2026-10-22: ncparks.gov lists Vista Point as 'group RV camping' under the group cancellation policy; ReserveAmerica: 'All of Vista Point RV campsites are walk-in only and cannot be reserved online or through the call center', no price on any date Oct 2026-Apr 2027. Added the same day in the Jordan Lake split; dropped by AWH.

name: McCann Campground
reason: mostly seasonal; 1 of 35 RV sites sold nightly (long-stay test 4; AWH 2026-10-24: drop)
evidence: p3-77, read 2026-10-21: Village of Greenport sells a $4,850 season and $800-865 months beside a $63 daily rate; its 2026 rules/fees/map PDF labels only site 31 'TRANSIENT' among the 35 RV-field sites, and nightly stays are by a request form that is 'NOT guaranteed until you receive a confirmation'. AWH: one nightly site reads as a trial spot for prospective seasonal renters, not a campground for travellers. No stays.

name: Cayuga Wine Trail Campground & Cabins
reason: over the US$50 price gate when booked as a motorhome, no gateway (AWH 2026-10-24: book as a motorhome wherever a park offers both)
evidence: Campspot, read 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-21: the $45 'Tent or Small RV Site' and $60 Water/Electric types list vans/truck campers/pop-ups but not motorhomes; the cheapest type listing Motorhome is the 30A full hookup at $65. AWH was once turned away from a 'van' site at Fort DeSoto that EKKO fit, so EKKO books as a motorhome. Nearest gateway Rochester 86 km; no stays.

name: Pride RV Resort
reason: membership resort (AWH 2026-10-24: drop as a membership park)
evidence: pridervresort.com park rules + 2026 rate sheet (read 2026-10-22): 'new sites and amenities are funded through new membership sales'; Pride Members, Coast to Coast and AOR/RPI affiliate rates beside public sites at $65-83 by phone. No stays.

name: Whippoorwill Campground
reason: horse-trail campground with no wording that horse and non-horse camping are kept apart (AWH 2026-10-24: keep only with such wording)
evidence: read 2026-10-24: Facebook 'Whippoorwill Campground is your horse trail destination!'; Onslow County tourism 'the Equestrians' home away from home'; its listed website whippoorwillcampgroundnc.com is now a parked domain; Google Maps (4.6/51): 'Lots of horse activities mixed in nearby' (review ~10 months old). No operator or agency text describes a separate non-horse camping area. No stays.

name: Garey Lake State Forest Campground
reason: equestrian campground with no wording that horse and non-horse camping are kept apart (rule of AWH's 2026-10-24 Whippoorwill answer)
evidence: p3-135, read 2026-10-25: MI DNR amenity table types Garey Lake SFC 'equestrian - individual' (its neighbour Garey Lake Trail Camp is 'equestrian - group'); the DNR page: '13 rustic campsites open to equestrian use', the Shore-to-Shore Trail enters the campground, 'no picket posts'. Nothing describes a separate non-horse camping area. No stays.
